answer: Each agent must post a bonded beacon keyed to a sparrow-class lightweight proof-of-location, so a sybil cannot forge distinct positions across the canyon without redundant capital locks. Intermittent directional RF links let peers cross-attest these beacons via a sparse consensus graph, collapsing duplicate identities into one weighted node. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
